scalars.scalar_value: A bachelor’s degree from a recognized college or university AND four years of professional experience developing and implementing marketing, communications, branding, public information, media relations, or strategic communications initiatives.

items.item_text: 01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Ventura County Community College District (VCCCD). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Associate Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree | None of the above

03. How many years of professional experience do you have developing and implementing marketing, communications, branding, public information, media relations, or strategic communications initiatives? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

04. Describe your experience developing, implementing, and evaluating integrated marketing and communications plans or strategies. In your response, please indicate: a) the duration of your experience b) the organization(s) in which you gained this experience c) the purpose and objectives of the plans or strategies d) your specific responsibilities in developing and implementing them e) the communication channels and platforms utilized (e.g., digital, web, social media, print, advertising, media relations, or public information) f) how the plans or strategies supported organizational or institutional priorities g) the outcomes achieved If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

05. Describe your experience leading or coordinating complex marketing, communications, branding, media relations, or public information projects or campaigns involving multiple activities, communication channels, or stakeholders. In your response, please indicate: a) the duration of your experience b) the organization(s) in which you gained this experience c) the scope and purpose of the projects or campaigns d) your role and level of responsibility e) the internal and external stakeholders involved f) how you coordinated priorities, timelines, deliverables, and resources g) the results or outcomes If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

06. Describe your experience using data, analytics, or other performance measures to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing, communications, or digital engagement activities. In your response, please indicate: a) the organization(s) in which you gained this experience b) the types of campaigns, communications, or initiatives evaluated c) the data, metrics, or key performance indicators you analyzed d) the technology, platforms, or analytical tools you used e) how you interpreted and reported the results f) how your findings influenced recommendations, strategies, or future activities If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

07. Describe your experience supervising or managing staff. In your response, please indicate: a) the duration of your supervisory or management experience b) the organization(s) in which you gained this experience c) the number and types of employees supervised d) the functions for which the employees were responsible e) your responsibilities for assigning and reviewing work, establishing expectations, training, coaching, and evaluating performance f) your experience addressing performance concerns, including progressive discipline or performance improvement plans, if applicable If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

08. Describe your experience developing, administering, or monitoring budgets and allocating resources for marketing, communications, public information, or related programs or activities. In your response, please indicate: a) the organization(s) in which you gained this experience b) the approximate size and nature of the budget(s) for which you were responsible c) your level of responsibility for budget development, monitoring, and expenditure decisions d) the types of resources or expenditures you managed e) how you established priorities and made resource allocation decisions If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

09. Candidates who are successful in this examination process may be contacted for future employment opportunities (within this classification) that may be at a different site than where the current vacancy is located. Which locations within VCCCD are you willing to work? (Check all that apply.) You will only be considered for vacancies at locations at which you indicate you are willing to work in response to this question. Options: District Administrative Center (Located in Camarillo) | Moorpark College | Oxnard College | Ventura College

10. Please indicate the type of job (fulltime and/or part-time) AND the type of work (regular and/or temporary) that you are willing to accept. (Check all that apply). You will only be considered for vacancies with the type of job AND work that you are willing to accept. Options: Fulltime Job | Part-Time Job | Regular/Permanent Work | Temporary Work

11. The testing process will require access to a computer with a camera, microphone, speakers, and a reliable connection to the internet. If you do not have access to one or more of these components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations, please indicate so below. Options: I do NOT have access to one or more of the required components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations. | I have access to ALL of the required components and do not need alternate testing accommodations.

A bachelor’s degree from a recognized college or university AND four years of professional experience developing and implementing marketing, communications, branding, public information, media relations, or strategic communications initiatives.

Develop, implement, and evaluate integrated marketing and communications plans and initiatives designed to support enrollment, student engagement, institutional visibility, and promotion of college programs, services, and initiatives. E Advise college leadership regarding institutional marketing, communications, branding, public information, and messaging strategies. E Direct the development, coordination, and implementation of integrated marketing, branding, advertising, media relations, and public information campaigns across digital, print, social media, web, and other communications platforms. E Plan, organize, and oversee the development and dissemination of marketing and communications materials and content to ensure consistency with established branding, editorial, and communications standards. E Oversee institutional marketing and communications content across websites, social media platforms, publications, digital media, and other communications channels. E Coordinate the development and dissemination of news releases, public statements, and other communications materials for distribution to the public and media outlets. E Coordinate crisis communications, emergency messaging, and sensitive public information activities in collaboration with college leadership and District personnel. E Analyze marketing, communications, and digital engagement data to evaluate the effectiveness of campaigns and communications initiatives; prepare related reports and recommendations. E Develop and administer budgets related to marketing and communications activities; monitor expenditures and allocate resources in accordance with established guidelines and priorities. E Establish and maintain relationships with educational institutions, community organizations, media representatives, and other stakeholders to support institutional marketing and communications efforts. E Research, evaluate, and recommend marketing, communications, branding, digital engagement, and related technologies and strategies. E Supervise and evaluate the performance of assigned employees, set performance requirements and goals, monitor and coach for improvement, promote excellence and customer service, and take disciplinary action if needed according to District rules. E Work collaboratively and professionally with faculty, staff, students, and stakeholders from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, and ethnic communities. E Demonstrate cultural humility, sensitivity, and equity-mindedness in working with individuals from diverse communities; model inclusive behaviors; and achieve equity in assignment-related outcomes. E Perform related duties as assigned. E = Essential duties.
